author: Seung Wook
problem: Read N two-character strings. Print Yes if every string starts with one of H, D, C, S, its second character is one of A, 2-9, T, J, Q, K, and no two strings are the same; otherwise print No.
bug_description: The duplicate test is negated (not s in spawned), so every new card is rejected and the answer is No whenever the cards are valid and distinct.

comments.accurate: Checks that every card has a valid suit and rank and that no card appears twice
comments.wrong_behavior: Checks that every card has a valid suit and rank and is one of the cards already seen
comments.wrong_location: Card condition verified; check that the rank list covers every allowed rank character

source.buggy_line: if not s[0] in one or not s[1] in two or not s in spawned:
source.fixed_line: if not s[0] in one or not s[1] in two or s in spawned:
